wish: someone should make an app that simulates electrical circuits
spec:
Place wires, batteries, resistors, bulbs and switches on a dot grid and it solves the DC circuit live with nodal analysis.
Pick a part, tap a line between two dots to place it, tap a part to edit its value, flip it or remove it; tap a switch to open or close it.
It does not do AC, capacitors, inductors, diodes or time-varying behaviour; batteries and wires are near-ideal (10 and 1 milliohm).
